english.title: Wilful obstruction of a person exercising section 77 powers - A-s.B. Act 2003
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(a)_[owner]_
(b)_[occupier]_

of land, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), who had not taken action in accordance with a remedial notice issued under section 69 of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003, wilfully obstructed a person authorised by the relevant authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..), acting in the exercise of powers under section 77 of the Act to enter your land and take the action required by the remedial notice
english.legislation: Contrary to section 77 of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003.

english.notes:
(i) A person shall not enter land in the exercise of a power conferred by this section unless at least 7 days' notice of the intended entry has been given to every occupier of the land. (section 77(5)).
(ii) A person authorised under this section to enter land shall, if so required, produce evidence of his authority before entering; and shall produce such evidence if required to do so at any time while he remains on the land. (section 77(6)
(iii) A person who enters land in the exercise of a power conferred by this section may use a vehicle to enter the land; take with him such other persons as may be necessary, take with him equipment and materials needed for the purpose of taking the required action. (Section 77(7)).
